What’s wrong with Summer Street today?
● Street is not comfortable for cyclists and
pedestrians in many locations
● Traffic speeds can reach nearly 50 MPH in
some segments and 1 in 10 cars are
exceeding 40 MPH
● Congestion in key locations delays transit
and Port of Boston traffic

What’s wrong with Summer Street today?
● Trips between South Boston and
Downtown are time consuming for
short distances
● Buses get stuck in traffic and
backups along Summer Street
● The Silver Line and Route 7 operate
at unacceptable levels of crowding
during peak periods which delays
service and causes reliability issues.

Existing transportation infrastructure will
not handle future demand caused by
population and job growth if we do
nothing.
Approaching transportation with a “business as
usual” approach will negatively impact residents,
employment competitiveness, and the
functionality of the Port of Boston as traffic
increases over the coming years. This traffic will
also spill over into surrounding neighborhoods as
commuters seek alternative routes.
